chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from Ibn Faddal, from Ali ibn Shajara, from Bashir al-Nabbal, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"When you are granted something, stick to it."

key_terms.الْزَمْهُ: Stick to it / Maintain it / Hold onto it
key_terms.شَيْءٍ: Something (referring to wealth, property, or assets)

ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic ethical advice regarding the preservation of received wealth?
ai.summary: In the context of trade ethics within *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) advises steadfastness in one's acquired wealth or trade goods, emphasizing the preservation of blessings through consistency rather than hasty disposal. This directive reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on *istiqra'* (stability) in business dealings, ensuring that wealth is managed with the intention of long-term growth and gratitude, thereby avoiding the spiritual and material pitfalls of negligence.
